user.title: Mailbox
user.description: The IMAP mailbox that receives the calendar invitations. Use an app password where your mail provider offers one.

data_description.username: Usually the full email address. It is also the calendar's own address.
data_description.processed_keyword: Private IMAP keyword that marks a processed message. Changing it later makes every message in the folder look new.

ics.title: Calendar
ics.description: Name of the calendar and the .ics file it is stored in.

data_description.ics_path: Absolute path inside the configuration folder. An existing file is kept and used.

caldav.title: CalDAV calendar
caldav.description: Name of the calendar, and the CalDAV server and login. The calendars on the server are listed next. The calendar can be shared with people: events they create there are shown but never changed or removed.

data_description.caldav_server: The server address, for example cloud.example.com. A calendar's own URL works too.
data_description.caldav_password: Use an app password (Nextcloud: Personal settings, Security, Devices & sessions).

caldav_calendar.title: Choose the calendar
caldav_calendar.description: Found {count} calendar(s) for events that this login can write to.

reauth_confirm.title: Login failed
reauth_confirm.description: A login was rejected: IMAP {username} on {host}, or the CalDAV calendar {caldav}. Enter the new password; leave a field empty to keep the stored one.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Server, password, folder and calendar file of this calendar. The username ({username}) and the processed keyword ({keyword}) can't be changed here: for another mailbox, add a new entry.

data_description.folder: Mail in another folder is read as new (within the lookback window).
data_description.ics_path: Absolute path inside the configuration folder. Events are not moved: copy the old file there first to keep them.

reconfigure_caldav.title: Change connection
reconfigure_caldav.description: Server, passwords, folder and CalDAV calendar of this calendar. The username ({username}) and the processed keyword ({keyword}) can't be changed here: for another mailbox, add a new entry.

data_description.folder: Mail in another folder is read as new (within the lookback window).
data_description.caldav_url: Events are not moved to another calendar.
data_description.caldav_password: Empty keeps the current password. Use an app password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the IMAP server.
error.invalid_auth: Login rejected. Check username and password.
error.folder_not_found: The folder does not exist or can't be selected.
error.keywords_not_supported: This folder does not allow custom IMAP keywords, which are needed to mark processed mail.
error.invalid_keyword: Use letters, digits and simple punctuation only, no spaces.
error.invalid_path: Enter an absolute path to a file ending in .ics.
error.path_outside_config: The file must be inside the configuration folder.
error.path_not_writable: Home Assistant can't write to that location.
error.path_in_use: Another Invite Calendar entry already uses this file.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full http or https URL.
error.url_in_use: Another Invite Calendar entry already uses this calendar.
error.caldav_invalid_auth: The CalDAV server rejected the login.
error.caldav_not_calendar: That URL is not a calendar collection. Check the path.
error.caldav_cannot_connect: Could not connect to the CalDAV server.
error.mailbox_in_use: This mailbox folder is already used by another calendar.
error.caldav_no_calendars: No CalDAV calendar found that holds events and that this login can write to. Check the server address, or enter the calendar's own URL.

abort.already_configured: This mailbox folder is already set up.

event_not_found.message: No event with UID {uid} in this calendar.

event_not_managed.message: Event {uid} did not arrive by mail, so it is not answered.

event_no_organizer.message: Event {uid} has no organizer to answer, or the calendar organizes it itself.

end_before_start.message: The end must be after the start.

mixed_date_types.message: Start and end must both be dates or both be date and time.

summary_and_start_required.message: A summary and a start are required.

event_not_own.message: Event {uid} is organized by someone else; only events this calendar organizes can be changed.

rrule_on_occurrence.message: A repeat rule can only be changed on the whole series.

imap_unreachable.title: {name}: mailbox unreachable
imap_unreachable.description:
The mailbox on {host} could not be read for over an hour, so new invitations are not picked up. Last error: {error}

Check the server and the network, or change the server in the integration's Reconfigure. This goes away by itself once the mailbox can be read again.

store_unreachable.title: {name}: calendar unreachable
store_unreachable.description:
The calendar {store} could not be read or written for over an hour. Invitations stay in the mailbox and are applied once it works again. Last error: {error}

Check the server or the file, or change it in the integration's Reconfigure.

smtp_auth_failed.title: {name}: mail login rejected
smtp_auth_failed.description:
The mail server {host} rejected the login of {username} for outgoing mail, so replies and invitations are not sent. Last error: {error}

If the mailbox password changed, update it with Reconfigure; a separate SMTP password is set in the options. This goes away after the next message is sent.

smtp_sender_refused.title: {name}: sending as {address} refused
smtp_sender_refused.description:
The mail server {host} won't let {username} send as {address}, so replies and invitations are not sent. Last error: {error}

Allow {username} to send as {address} on the mail server (mailcow: the mailbox's sender settings), or use the mailbox's own login for SMTP in the options. This goes away after the next message is sent.

poll.name: Poll mailbox
poll.description: Checks the mailbox for new invitations now instead of waiting for the next scheduled poll.

accept_event.name: Accept event
accept_event.description: Sends an acceptance to the organizer of an invitation, under any accept policy. Does nothing when the current version was already accepted.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: UID of the event, as returned by list_events.

decline_event.name: Decline event
decline_event.description: Sends a decline to the organizer of an invitation, or of one occurrence of a series, under any accept policy, and leaves it out of the calendar. Works on an invitation that was already accepted. Does nothing when the current version was already declined.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: UID of the event, as returned by list_events.

recurrence_id.name: Occurrence
recurrence_id.description: recurrence_id from list_events: decline only that occurrence of a series.

list_events.name: List events
list_events.description: Occurrences in a window with UID, organizer, attendees and whether the calendar manages and accepted them. Default: the next 7 days.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the window. Default: now.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Length of the window when no end is given. Default: 7 days.

create_event.name: Create event
create_event.description: Adds an event organized by this calendar and emails the invitation to the attendees. Returns the UID.

start_date_time.name: Start
start_date_time.description: Start date and time. Naive times are local.

end_date_time.name: End
end_date_time.description: End date and time. Default: one hour after the start.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Start of an all day event.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Day after the last day of an all day event. Default: one day.

description.name: Description
description.description: Free text, kept as is (markers for automations are safe here).

attendees.name: Attendees
attendees.description: Email addresses that receive the invitation.

rrule.name: Repeat
rrule.description: RFC 5545 rule, for example FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=4 or FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20261231. Empty in update_event stops the repetition.

update_event.name: Update event
update_event.description: Changes an event this calendar organizes, or one occurrence of it, and emails the update. Fields left out stay as they are; removed attendees get a cancellation.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: UID of an event this calendar organizes, as returned by create_event or list_events.

recurrence_id.name: Occurrence
recurrence_id.description: recurrence_id from list_events: change or cancel only that occurrence of a series.

start_date_time.name: Start
start_date_time.description: Start date and time. Naive times are local.

end_date_time.name: End
end_date_time.description: End date and time. Default: one hour after the start.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Start of an all day event.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Day after the last day of an all day event. Default: one day.

description.name: Description
description.description: Free text, kept as is (markers for automations are safe here).

attendees.name: Attendees
attendees.description: Email addresses that receive the invitation.

rrule.name: Repeat
rrule.description: RFC 5545 rule, for example FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=4 or FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=20261231. Empty in update_event stops the repetition.

cancel_event.name: Cancel event
cancel_event.description: Cancels an event this calendar organizes, or one occurrence of it, and emails the cancellation. If the mail can't be sent nothing changes.

uid.name: UID
uid.description: UID of an event this calendar organizes, as returned by create_event or list_events.

recurrence_id.name: Occurrence
recurrence_id.description: recurrence_id from list_events: change or cancel only that occurrence of a series.

init.title: Invite Calendar options
init.description: Replies are sent as {address}. Mail goes out through {smtp_host} with the mailbox login unless the SMTP section says otherwise.

data.retention_days: Remove events this many days after they ended
data.lookback_days: Only read mail from the last (days)

data_description.accept_policy: Never: no replies. Always: accept every invitation. If it has a location: accept once a location is set. If the time is free: accept, or decline when something already takes that time (for a series only the clashing dates). Manual: only the accept_event and decline_event actions answer, so an automation decides.
data_description.missing_location_reply: Email the organizer of an invitation without a location.
data_description.missing_location_text: One sentence, included in that email.
data_description.retention_days: 0 keeps everything. On a CalDAV calendar only events that arrived by mail are ever removed.
data_description.lookback_days: 0 reads the whole folder. Older unprocessed mail is left alone; raising this later reads it after all.
data_description.attendee_cn: How the calendar is named in its acceptance.

smtp.name: Outgoing mail (SMTP)
smtp.description: Leave empty to send with the mailbox host and login on port 587 (STARTTLS). Port 465 uses implicit TLS.

error.smtp_invalid_auth: The SMTP server rejected the login.
error.smtp_cannot_connect: Could not connect to the SMTP server.
error.username_not_address: Replies need an email address: the mailbox username is not one.
